acceptance_criteria: Every new record from all five controller streams validates against one versioned envelope before append.
All streams use the same observedAt, component, recordKind, level, outcome, runId, cycleId, and sequence field names and bounded vocabularies.
Every deadman alert, suppression, and recovery serialization has an authoritative observation timestamp and cycle identity.
Two daemon cycles under one PID remain distinguishable, and records are totally ordered within each process run.
Each cycle emits exactly one terminal completion or failure receipt linked to its preceding records, duration, and truthful partial-progress counters.
Restart creates a new run identity while preserving only explicitly typed content-free correlation to durable state generation.
Unknown vocabulary, caller collision, or malformed correlation fails before append without hiding the underlying bounded safe failure class.
Inline-tail selection for #2136 can require typed correlation and an observation window without filename or global-tail heuristics.
Retention work for #2135 preserves envelope validity, ordering, run and cycle continuity, private permissions, and a bounded rotation receipt.
Legacy records parse as legacy_unversioned, and missing envelope fields are never invented as authoritative facts.
Mutation tests fail when any required field, collision check, cycle terminal receipt, or one of the five producer adapters is removed.

Serialized records and public verification contain no host, user, account, raw event identity, message, destination, path, command, raw error, credential, or private topology; domain-separated opaque correlation digests remain permitted.
blast_radius: Dispatcher, collector, heartbeat-watchdog, q-loop, and deadman controller diagnostics; incident investigation and cross-stream queries; inline-tail correlation for #2136; retention and ordering work for #2135; shared Python observability primitives in #2464; legacy and rotated JSONL readers; and privacy guarantees for durable diagnostic metadata.
evidence_summary: Exact pinned blobs confirm five independently shaped controller-log writers: dispatcher and collector add time and pid around caller payloads, watchdog adds time and kind, q-loop event records add ts, time, and kind, and health-check's private JSONL writer adds time and pid. None supplies a shared versioned controller-log envelope, bounded component or level vocabulary, process-run identity, per-cycle identity, or monotonic record sequence. Exact AST counts reproduce 47 dispatcher, 32 collector, 9 watchdog, 12 q-loop, and 3 deadman call sites, while the inspected focused tests assert selected record names or fields rather than one closed-world parity contract. The issue's deadman canary is not emitted-shape proof: append_deadman_log passes the caller payload to append_private_jsonl, which injects time and pid before serialization. Complete pagination across all 38 open pull requests and 1,327 changed-file entries found no implementation owner; draft PR #2495 is a collision on dispatcher, health-check, and a dispatcher test. A final path-level audit found every recorded decisive, test, and affected path disjoint from the exact 6e1672766027c16ecb06f5e122b491c0e5a0a83f to 45f4889ab5f971d920ca6a05bf857d326c42b81d delta; API and SSH main matched the latter revision, so this record is safely repinned. A final path-level audit found every recorded decisive, test, and affected path disjoint from the exact 45f4889ab5f971d920ca6a05bf857d326c42b81d to c37df83897ce9cd02829289f9f05b01347e4b0de delta; API and SSH main matched the latter revision, so this record is safely repinned. A final path-level audit found every recorded decisive, test, and affected path disjoint from the exact c37df83897ce9cd02829289f9f05b01347e4b0de to f0ece2d18883a66f04892a46669b3547e5bdf2b1 delta; API and SSH main matched the latter revision, so this record is safely repinned.
falsifier_or_remaining_gap: A shared writer that validates every new record against one versioned metadata-only envelope, assigns distinct run and cycle identities plus a monotonic sequence, and passes a five-producer parity and legacy-archive matrix would falsify the surviving defect. Implementation must also mutation-kill caller collisions and cycle-terminal omissions. This bounded audit did not execute the issue's writer canary or focused suites because their harnesses create filesystem artifacts; source-level emitted-shape proof contradicts only the timestamp-free deadman subclaim.
impact: Controller records cannot be deterministically joined into one outage timeline or attributed to a specific iteration. Reused daemon PIDs and timestamps cannot distinguish overlapping, restarted, partial, or repeated cycles, and source-specific discriminator fields force heuristic parsing. Missing version and collision rules let record shape drift silently.
lead_verification_obligations: Re-read live #2508 identity, labels, body hash, and remote main immediately before registry integration or metadata mutation.
Preserve the partial classification unless emitted deadman bytes on the exact implementation base prove the timestamp-free subclaim.
Re-enumerate all open pull-request files before assigning an owner, with explicit collision review of preservation draft #2495.
Reconcile this log-envelope boundary with #2386, #2464, #2506, #2135, and #2136 without combining live migration, rotation, deployment, restart, or message delivery into the draft.
Require RED/GREEN five-producer envelope parity, caller-collision, daemon restart, overlapping-cycle, terminal failure, legacy archive, rotation, and privacy tests on the exact implementation head.
Verify any shared module is included and hashed in every affected deployable bundle and that mixed script or module generations fail closed.

partial_findings.summary: The issue says serialized deadman JSONL has no timestamp and presents an intercepted pre-writer payload as emitted shape. Pinned append_private_jsonl injects time and pid before serializing every append_deadman_log payload, so that subclaim is stale even though deadman still lacks the common envelope and cycle identity.

suggested_remediation: Define one deployable versioned controller-log envelope builder and writer, coordinated with the shared Python primitives in #2464. Give it canonical observedAt, bounded component, recordKind, level, and outcome vocabularies, process-start runId, per-iteration cycleId, monotonic sequence, bounded safe failure classes, typed content-free correlation fields, and collision rejection. Migrate the five producers with explicit cycle start, completion, and failure receipts; preserve legacy records through an explicit legacy_unversioned parse result; and apply #2386's metadata-only boundary before serialization.
